name: parallel-design-exploration
title: Parallel Design Exploration
description: Standalone Open Design scenario for persistent parallel design exploration: compare rendered sibling options in one visible design space, preserve reliable current-state evidence when available, keep stable state identities across turns, and extend the same exploration artifact without rewriting delivered history.

query.en: Explore this design brief through several materially different rendered options in one persistent comparison canvas. Use reliable existing design context as baseline evidence when available. On follow-up turns, extend the same primary artifact with new states while keeping previously delivered states intact, and let me decide when to converge.
query.zh-CN: 针对这个设计需求，在同一个持续存在的比较画布中生成多个实质不同、可直接判断的设计方案。如果存在可靠的现有设计上下文，将其作为基线证据保留。后续轮次继续扩展同一个主产物，以新状态推进探索，同时保持已经交付的历史状态完整，并由我决定何时收敛。
